summary: Seeking can be a request, a search, or a discipline. 求道 is a lexical bridge toward the first realm without claiming the same sense in every tradition.

satellites.title: Seek Within
satellites.evidence: Analects 15.21 contrasts the exemplary person who seeks from themselves with the petty person who seeks from others. Seeking can turn inward without becoming self-absorption.

satellites.title: Seeking the Strayed Heart
satellites.evidence: Mencius: 仁，人心也；義，人路也 … 人有雞犬放，則知求之；有放心，而不知求。學問之道無他，求其放心而已矣 — people seek their strayed chickens and dogs but not their strayed heart; “the way of learning is nothing else: to seek the strayed heart.”
